title: How Does a Circuit Work?
hook: A light bulb is a tiny closed racetrack…
narration: A light bulb is a tiny closed racetrack for charge.
Today's question: How Does a Circuit Work?.
A battery pushes electric charge around a complete loop called a circuit.
Hold the cause in your head, then the effect.
If the loop breaks — switch open, loose wire — the race stops and the light goes out.
This is the part most people skip. Do not skip it.
Series shares one path. Parallel gives each bulb its own path. That’s the school-ready idea.
If you can say why how does a circuit work works, you understood the film.
No gore. Just the model. School-safe.
The pictures today are a new circuit world. Not yesterday's film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for how does a circuit work.
Tomorrow a different 3D film. New scene. New true fact.
